# RC47 — Copy current problem context

Date: 2026-07-28

Workspace: `/path/to/projects/w.scrpt`

Git: not a Git repository in this workspace; checkpoint identity is the source tree at this path plus the artifacts below.

## Change

- Added `Esc c Y` / `code.copy-problem` / `Copy Current Problem`.
- The command copies the current-line LSP diagnostic as `path:line:column: LSP severity [source]: message`.
- If no current-line LSP diagnostic is available, it falls back to a task-derived Problem on the same active file and line, using the same bounded parser as `Esc c p`.
- The editor-local register is always updated; any OSC 52 system-clipboard attempt remains bounded and best-effort through the existing copy pipeline.
- Updated the CODE action-layer hint to show `y/Y` copy routes.
- The README namespace table and iPad QA matrix now cover both file-location copy and current-problem copy.
